needs-server: staticCapable is false or the plugin has routes
not-stable: lifecycle is experimental, deprecated or obsolete
reaches-any-host: egress lists { any: true } (destinations cannot be listed in advance)
admin-chosen-hosts: egress or privacy.recipients name a setting (admins choose where data goes)
reaches-given-url: egress lists { input: url } (only the host of the URL a person gives, during that call)
needs-reachable-server: a public or optional-auth operation: visitors or other services must be able to reach the backend, which the desktop app and the browser cannot offer (spec/14)
not-in-browser: cannot run on the browser target (haxcms-browser): no nodejs runtime, a need the browser lacks, or targets leaves it out
not-on-desktop: cannot run on the desktop target (haxcms-desktop): no nodejs runtime or targets leaves it out
